response.justification: Bogdan is a talented and versatile senior full-stack/systems engineer with strong C/C++ and Linux experience from earlier in his career, but the role requires native-level Japanese and hands-on Linux kernel source modification plus deep embedded networking security expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips) that are entirely absent from his profile. His recent work is focused on web, TypeScript/Node.js, and AI tooling, far from embedded firmware or LAN-switch security features.
strengths: Extensive senior-level software engineering experience across many domains
Solid C/C++ background (National Instruments, robotics, low-level systems)
Demonstrated Linux and systems-level experience (Dlang low-latency services, DevOps/CI infrastructure)
concerns: No native or listed Japanese language proficiency, which is a hard requirement
No evidence of Linux kernel source-code investigation/modification experience
No experience with embedded networking security (MACsec, 802.1X, switch chips, NETCONF/SNMP)

key_factors.factor: No Linux kernel or embedded security/networking experience
